caption: The drawing depicts a single arched doorway set in a stone wall. The doorway is closed by a reddish-brown wooden door, which is surrounded by intricately carved stonework. The arch above the door is highlighted with decorative molding in light gray tones, which also appear on the vertical sides of the door frame. Gray stone blocks, some of which appear irregular and weathered, form the wall surrounding the door, with the areas above and to the sides of the arch showing rough, partially broken stones. The floor in front of the doorway is a plain, light gray-brown surface. The composition is centered, with the arched door and its decorative stonework as the main focal point. The background is a pale, off-white shade, with some faint discoloration marks, allowing the doorway and the surrounding stones to stand out clearly.
title: Doorway, Stone
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
